mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Victory!</titleLeft><mainText><font color='#FDD017' >''Kha'Zix has slain his bestial nemesis Rengar, evolving into the ultimate predator.''</font></mainText>
<titleLeft>Defeat!</titleLeft><mainText><font color='#FDD017' >''Kha'Zix has slain his bestial nemesis Rengar, evolving into the ultimate predator.''</font></mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Wings</font>, Leap's range increases by 200 and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Evolution: Wings</titleLeft><mainText>Increases Leap's range by 200. On champion kill or assist, Leap's cooldown resets.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Unseen Threat</titleLeft><mainText>Kha'Zix's next basic attack against a champion deals bonus magic damage and slows.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Unseen ThreatNearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets.

When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal @f1@ (+@f2@) bonus magic damage and slow them by @f3@% for 2 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Nearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets.

When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow them for a few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, his next Attack against a champion deals an additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slows by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Enemies with no nearby allies become Isolated.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Deals physical damage to the target. Damage increased on <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Reaper Claws</font>, this refunds a percent of it's cooldown against <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets. Kha'Zix also gains increased range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Taste Their Fear (<font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font>)</titleLeft><mainText>Taste Their Fear deals bonus damage to targets <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> away from their allies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Evolution: Reaper Claws</titleLeft><mainText>Taste Their Fear refunds a portion of it's cooldown against <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets. Increases the range of Taste Their Fear and Kha'Zix's basic attacks.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Each rank allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, giving it a unique additional effect. When activated, Kha'Zix becomes <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font>, triggering Unseen Threat and increasing Move Speed. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Adaptive Cloaking</font>, Void Assault gains increased <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisibility</font> duration, and an additional use.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Evolution: Adaptive Cloaking</titleLeft><mainText>Void Assault has increased duration, and an additional use.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Out of Combat</titleLeft><mainText>Kha'Zix is out of combat.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Void Assault</titleLeft><mainText>Kha'Zix is <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font> and can only be revealed by nearby enemy Turrets.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kha'Zix fires exploding spikes that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Kha'Zix is healed if he is also within the explosion radius. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Spike Racks</font>, Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone, slow enemies hit, and reveals enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets are slowed for extra.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Evolution: Spike Racks</titleLeft><mainText>Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone and slows enemies hit. <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets are slowed for extra.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Evolved Void Spike</titleLeft><mainText>The enemy is <status>Slowed</status> by Kha'Zix. <keywordMajor>Isolated</keywordMajor> enemies are <status>Slowed</status> more.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
